web_fixture.snippet: Retention periods under the current schedule: water samples must be retained for 90 days, receipts and printouts for 24 months.
web_fixture.content:
# Wessex scheme - retention periods for laboratory records

Current schedule, issued 12 May 2026. Applies to laboratories holding the
Wessex water accreditation.

Water samples must be retained for 90 days. Receipt books and instrument
printouts are retained for 24 months. Laboratories copy the periods into their
own retention worksheet when the schedule changes.

Queries: scheme@wessex-accreditation.example

web_fixture.title: Retention questions answered - Wessex scheme
web_fixture.snippet: Water samples are held for 90 days under the current schedule; the period is counted from the day the sample is booked in.
web_fixture.content:
# Retention questions answered - Wessex scheme

How long are water samples kept?
Water samples are held for 90 days under the current schedule. The period runs from the day the sample is booked in at the laboratory.

Do printouts count as records?
Yes. Instrument printouts follow the 24 month period.

laboratory copies them in when the schedule changes.
